title: 'When it wins a combat this turn, gain 2 XP.' clause is not implemented — parser output / chain effect for Grim Resolve contains only {type:'modify-might', amount:3, duration:'turn'}; no delayed/turn-scoped win-combat trigger is attached to the buffed unit.
expected: Card def /root/src/tcg/tcg-engines/packages/riftbound-cards/src/cards/unl/grim-resolve.ts:4-16 has no hand-authored `abilities`, so enrich-cards.ts:30 runs parseAbilities on rulesText. Running the parser on the exact rulesText yields a single ability {type:'spell', timing:'action', effect:{type:'modify-might', amount:3, duration:'turn', target:{type:'unit',controller:'friendly'}}} — the "When it wins a combat this turn, gain 2 XP" sentence is silently dropped (spells.ts:170 parseEffects returns only the might buff). The pre-generated data/sets/unl.json:3848 entry likewise has only keyword Action + modify-might. Parser trigger patterns only know "When I win a combat" / "When you win a combat" (trigger-patterns.ts:40,104); there is no "When it wins a combat this turn" delayed-trigger pattern, and no engine special-case for unl-095-219. Hence no win-combat XP trigger is ever attached to the buffed unit and xp stays 0.
observed: Combat resolved, Recruit killed, player-1 conquered the battlefield (VP 0->1, controller player-1, Poro survived with 0 damage) but players['player-1'].xp stayed 0. Chain item effect was only modify-might; no trigger fired.

history.note: emit win-combat for surviving winners + new delayed-trigger effect; Grim Resolve explicit abilities

resolution.note: emit win-combat for surviving winners + new delayed-trigger effect; Grim Resolve explicit abilities
